1 1:25 What effect did the study have on her??It made her rethink her whole approach to stress.
2 1:43 What two questions did the researchers ask the participants??They asked how much stress people had experienced in the last year and whether they believed stress was harmful to their health.
3 2:08 Which group of people had an increased risk of dying??People who experienced a lot of stress and also believed that stress was harmful had a 43% increased risk of dying.
4 2:24 Who had the lowest risk of dying??People who experienced a lot of stress but did not view stress as harmful.
5 2:37 What estimate did the researchers make??They estimated that over eight years, 182,000 Americans died prematurely — not from stress itself, but from the belief that stress is bad for them.
6 2:55 If the estimate was correct, what would be the 15th largest cause of death in the US??Believing that stress is bad for you — killing more people than skin cancer, HIV/AIDS, and homicide.
7 3:08 Why did the study freak her out??Because she had spent years telling people that stress was bad for their health, and the study suggested that message might itself be harmful.
